findings.explanation: You are required to perform open-ended additional duties without any change-order mechanism or guaranteed extra pay.
findings.suggested_change: The Contractor shall perform the services specified in this Agreement, and any additional services requested by the Client shall be subject to a separate written change order and additional compensation.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, thank you for sharing the paperwork. Before signing the agreement, I would like to request a small revision to the relevant clause: - The current wording requires open-ended additional duties without any change-order mechanism or guaranteed extra pay, so I propose we update it to state that the Contractor shall perform the services specified in this Agreement, and any additional services requested by the Client shall be subject to a separate written change order and additional compensation. Please let me know if this works for you. Best regards,
